whatThisIs: A repair return for a repair the Captain integrated without a return row that claims it, so the state machine can see it. It grants no PASS: the family goes to a fresh independent read, which decides.
whyItExists: VF10 failed rcap-tx-custom-pleading at 88d688b8b on KNOWN_PREFILLS, REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING and SELF_HELP_STOP. The SELF_HELP_STOP repair -- the 3 common and 17 route-specific stop conditions carried into the filing instructions -- landed in the Captain integration commit a8931f0e0 (fix(packet-factory): return focused FIX01 repairs), which changed this family's participant-instructions.md and builder; FIX01's own rows for the family read STOPPED with obligationRepaired naming SELF_HELP_STOP, so no completed row claims it. FIX29 (d214579b3) re-measured the delivered bytes and found all 26 registry stop conditions printed verbatim in both fixtures and the markdown, and honestly listed SELF_HELP_STOP as not discharged by its own row. The reader that supersedes a FAIL needs a completed row naming the obligation; this is that row, written by the party that integrated the change.
